DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC)

The labs show a classic cholestatic pattern with significantly elevated Alkaline Phosphatase (460 U/L) and mild transaminitis, while bilirubin is only mildly elevated. Given your severe pruritus and fatigue, I need to check your serum IgG levels and order an Antimitochondrial Antibody (AMA) test to confirm the diagnosis.
